kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team, I am writing to express my interest in the Software Engineering Intern (Full Stack) role at Joveo in Bengaluru. As an MCA student at PES University with practical full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which was deployed live for real customer bookings. Additionally, in my freelance work for an Australian restaurant, I delivered an end-to-end Point of Sale system featuring an Angular frontend and deployed on Azure. My project work includes Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform featuring an Express API, JWT authentication, and server-side request validation, as well as StaySphere, built with Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Passport.js authentication. These experiences have given me hands-on practice shipping features across the full stack using modern web technologies. I look forward to bringing my backend and frontend development skills to Joveo. Thank you for your time and consideration. Sincerely, Amaanuddin Ahmed
